purpose: 观察含 0xFF 主体的真实允许决策、唯一命中策略及实际版本。
command: go run ./cmd/darksafe review --archive ledger-access.audit --org acme --seq 2 --end-seq "$(cat ledger-access.end-seq)" --fingerprint "$(cat ledger-access.fingerprint)"
output:
target sequence: 2
original decision:
  allowed: true
  reason: "matched allow policy"
  matched policies: ["ledger-read-reader-\xff-account"]
  policy version: 1
recomputed decision:
  allowed: true
  reason: "matched allow policy"
  matched policies: ["ledger-read-reader-\xff-account"]
  policy version: 1
consistent: yes

purpose: 用同一归档观察含 0xFE 主体仅因自己的拒绝策略被拒绝。
command: go run ./cmd/darksafe review --archive ledger-access.audit --org acme --seq 3 --end-seq "$(cat ledger-access.end-seq)" --fingerprint "$(cat ledger-access.fingerprint)"
output:
target sequence: 3
original decision:
  allowed: false
  reason: "matched deny policy"
  matched policies: ["ledger-read-reader-\xfe-account"]
  policy version: 1
recomputed decision:
  allowed: false
  reason: "matched deny policy"
  matched policies: ["ledger-read-reader-\xfe-account"]
  policy version: 1
consistent: yes

purpose: 观察真正 U+FFFD 主体的默认拒绝、空命中列表及同一发布版本。
command: go run ./cmd/darksafe review --archive ledger-access.audit --org acme --seq 4 --end-seq "$(cat ledger-access.end-seq)" --fingerprint "$(cat ledger-access.fingerprint)"
output:
target sequence: 4
original decision:
  allowed: false

  matched policies: []
  policy version: 1

  matched policies: []
